title: Adenosine — Pediatric Stable SVT
purpose: Stable narrow-complex SVT in children. Rapid IV/IO push immediately followed by a saline flush (use a stopcock or two-syringe technique).

doses.notes: Push as fast as possible into the most proximal IV, immediately followed by a rapid saline flush.

rule.repeat: May repeat 0.2 mg/kg once more (max 12 mg) at some centres

contraindications: 2nd/3rd-degree AV block or sick sinus syndrome without a pacemaker
buildNote: Not for unstable SVT — that's synchronized cardioversion (0.5-1 J/kg, then 2 J/kg). Consider adding a cardioversion energy card cross-linked here.
